label: check-tools
why: Close three defects found while testing: (1) a hole in the void answered OK (the volume comparison was too tight for floating point), (2) a hole exactly tangent to a face gave a bad mesh, (3) there were no side holes (parallel to X and to Y) for parts that stand up.
changed: drill_hole refuses a hole that does not touch the part (relative threshold 1e-6) and warns about one that only grazes it; the cutter is nudged by 0.02% when the boolean gives a bad mesh; new tools drill_hole_x and drill_hole_y; segments configurable by environment (default 64, cap 256); new tests: pad and pocket land on the real surface, rectangles with no size, and 8 limit cases with coplanar faces.
